translation: On the fourth day the taiyin receives it; the taiyin vessel spreads in the stomach and connects with the throat, therefore there is abdominal fullness and dry throat. On the fifth day the shaoyin receives it; the shaoyin vessel pierces the kidney, connects with the lung system, and ties to the root of the tongue, therefore there is dry mouth, dry tongue, and thirst. On the sixth day the jueyin receives it; the jueyin vessel follows the genitals and finally connects with the liver, therefore there is vexation, fullness, and contraction of the scrotum.
